intro.title: Read: Dot and the Pup
intro.say: Dot is the castle cat. Listen to the story, and read along. Tap Start.

pages.text: Dot is a cat. Dot has a nap.
A pup runs in. The pup is wet.
The pup runs at the hen. The hen pecks the pup!
Dot hops up on a box. The pup can not get up.
Then Dot and the pup nap in the sun.

words.mean: A cat is a soft pet that says meow.
A pup is a baby dog.
A hen is a bird that lays eggs.
A box holds things. You can put things in it.

questions.q: Does the hen like the pup?
questions.say: Does the hen like the pup? Yes, or no?

questions.q: Why does Dot hop up on the box?

options.v: to get away from the pup

questions.answer: to get away from the pup
